intro.line1: Jinsi ya kutengeneza oda na proforma
intro.vo: How to make an order and a proforma invoice. Five simple steps.

beats.caption: Hatua 1: Chagua bidhaa anazotaka mteja
beats.vo: Step one. Choose the products your customer wants.

beats.caption: Hatua 2: Fungua kikapu na uchague mteja
beats.vo: Step two. Open the cart and choose the customer.

beats.caption: Hatua 3: Gusa Hifadhi Oda
beats.vo: Step three. Tap Save order, instead of completing the sale.

beats.caption: Hatua 4: Ipate oda kwenye kichupo cha Oda
beats.vo: Step four. Find your order in the orders tab.

beats.caption: Hatua 5: Fungua oda kushiriki proforma
beats.vo: Step five. Open the order to share the proforma invoice, and complete the sale when the customer pays.

endCard.title: Sasampa POS
endCard.subtitle: Tazama mafunzo mengine.
endCard.vo: That is all. Watch our other tutorials to learn more.
